item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"CIDE maintained an Office of Pedagogical Advice and Emotional Support, documented psychological evaluation and follow-up for a student interested in activating its protocol for discrimination and gender-based violence, provided individual support to 53 students, conducted group interventions addressing harassment and discrimination, and awarded 85 new socioeconomic maintenance scholarships from 88 applications; 190 undergraduate students held maintenance scholarships during the first semester.","notes":["The excerpt documents evaluation and follow-up connected to a potential protocol activation; it does not establish that CIDE handled a confirmed protocol case."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E010","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"CIDE academic personnel had press and internet collaborations during January–June 2023 on issues including the INAI, electoral reform and Plan B, the Supreme Court, the Guardia Nacional, militarization, violence, corruption, the president and the armed forces, and the prospective succession.","notes":["The excerpt supports listed press and internet collaborations and their topics, but it does not support the quantities of 154 radio/television participations or 12 titular researchers with regular press collaborations."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
